limitations: One full trial per serving variant; no repeatable incremental gain established.
Three earlier kernel output discrepancies remain unresolved despite passing repeats.
Candidate versus previous response texts differ in 31/1040 2B and 34/1040 4B requests.
Unused fusion and RMSNorm PDL prototypes were removed after narrow gains and larger-batch regressions.

serving.protocol: Repository sixpoint protocol: 3000 input / 1000 output tokens; concurrency 4/16/24/32/48/64; 1040 scored requests per model/variant; fresh service per variant, one full suite each; prewarm and internal warmup excluded; single RTX 5090 TP1 per model; same GPU within each model; BF16 activations and SSM, 19 GiB KV; 2B TRITON_ATTN/BF16 KV/hybrid head; 4B FLASHINFER/FP8 KV/default compact greedy head; fusion and norm PDL excluded.
serving.execution_notes: The two models run concurrently on distinct GPUs; variants for each model run sequentially on the same GPU.

single_pool.previous: pre-layout BF16: STATE_ROWS=1; full/8 warps through 256 head-rows; deferred/4 warps through 1024, 2 warps through 1536; original Triton above 1536; PDL disabled
single_pool.method: same state addresses/strides across variants; shuffled order; CUDA graph with four complete token steps across all pools; microseconds per pool per token step

multiple_pool.previous: pre-layout BF16: STATE_ROWS=1; full/8 warps through 256 head-rows; deferred/4 warps through 1024, 2 warps through 1536; original Triton above 1536; PDL disabled
multiple_pool.method: same state addresses/strides across variants; shuffled order; CUDA graph with four complete token steps across all pools; microseconds per pool per token step

validation.note: Earlier reports precede addition of default-off policy flags. Candidate device math/layout are unchanged. Final grouped-and-PDL validation explicitly enables both flags; default validation enables neither.
validation.policy: VLLM_MACH_MXFP8_BF16_GDN_GROUPED and VLLM_MACH_MXFP8_BF16_GDN_PDL default to 0; preceding BF16 dispatch is retained by default; fusion/norm PDL only live in benchmark tools.

removed_fusion_probe.method: one state pool; same addresses across variants; contiguous BF16 SSM and conv state; padded qkv/post-conv; unique positive indices; shuffled CUDA graph samples; four W4 token steps per graph unit; out-of-place conv chain proxy; microseconds per token step
